display_long_description:
Step onto the court in a realistic tennis simulator built around your swing. Feel the difference between a clean sweet-spot winner, a sliced return and a mistimed frame hit. Every serve, rally and match is yours to play—fully offline.

REALISTIC TENNIS, REAL CONTROL
• Swing naturally to hit topspin, slice, flat shots, lobs, volleys and smashes—no shot-selection combos.
• Physics-driven ball flight, spin and surface-specific bounces on hard, clay and grass courts.
• Responsive contact haptics, real ball-toss serves and adjustable Beginner-to-Simulation assists.

BUILD YOUR TENNIS CAREER
• Compete in a 12-event World Tour with seeded draws, rankings and Elo ratings.
• Face six AI play styles across 10 difficulty levels.
• Play Quick Match, six knockout cups or doubles with an AI partner.

TRAIN, IMPROVE, MASTER
• Seven ball-machine drill types, challenges and adaptive coaching.
• Swing Lab analyzes racket speed, swing path, impact and spin.
• Target practice, survival and serve-speed arcade challenges.
• Practice against a mixed reality wall in your room.

YOUR GAME, YOUR WAY
• Choose standing or seated play with five movement modes and personalized grip options.
• Challenge line calls, enjoy point replays and unlock six rackets by playing.

A complete single-player tennis game for Meta Quest. No internet, account, ads, in-app purchases or subscriptions.
